column5:
In the framework of the OBS4CLIM national project, LSCE has built a long term remote sensing network for greenhouse gas measurements in the total atmospheric column using EM27/SUN instruments. It consists of five stations that are located in the low latitudes : Bolivia (EAA), French Guyana (KOU), Morocco (AMV), Ivory Coast (LTO) and Amsterdam Island (AMS - Indian Ocean). The network focuses on long term observations and satellite cal/val activities. In addition, we has a sixth site at Saclay ICOS station, 20km south of Paris.
Each instrument are deployed with a dedicated enclosure system, allowing to perform automatic measurements.
An automatic data treatment chain, based on PROFFAST has also been developped. The data process is set up by the ICOS Atmospheric Thematic Centre as part of the European NUBICOS project. This involves not only calculating the total columns using the PROFFAST code, but also adapting the ICOS tools to ensure the configuration of the measurements and quality control of the data, with a high level of traceability.
